{{Top|leg|canon=Speeder van}}
A '''speedervan''', or a '''speeder van''', was a type of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle capable of holding at least six passengers, in addition to the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

During the wars between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a popular [[Unidentified speeder van model|model]] of speeder vans was used across the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]] by various warring factions.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
